first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation by accelerating time-to-value. I would verify both the onboarding and activation-messaging records to compare their evidence and choose the strongest intervention design. Promotional pricing is not preferred despite competitive pressure because prior evidence showed materially worse 30-day retention, conflicting with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The confirmed source evidence shows a 13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% improvement in 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable revenue. Activation messaging is a credible alternative, but its smaller retention lift makes it secondary. Avoid promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior evidence found material retention harm.
